title: Semantic Uncertainty: Linguistic Invariances for Uncertainty Estimation in Natural Language Generation
contribution: Clusters sampled answers by bidirectional entailment and computes entropy over meaning clusters instead of token strings.

title: Detecting hallucinations in large language models using semantic entropy
contribution: Applies semantic entropy to confabulation detection across QA, math and paragraph-length biographies, including a discrete variant usable without token probabilities.

title: SelfCheckGPT: Zero-Resource Black-Box Hallucination Detection for Generative Large Language Models
contribution: Scores each generated sentence by its agreement with stochastically resampled passages (BERTScore, QA, n-gram, NLI or prompt variants).

title: Generating with Confidence: Uncertainty Quantification for Black-box Large Language Models
contribution: Builds similarity graphs over sampled responses and derives black-box uncertainty and confidence from Laplacian eigenvalues, degree and eccentricity.

title: Semantic Entropy Probes: Robust and Cheap Hallucination Detection in LLMs
contribution: Trains linear probes on hidden states of a single generation to predict semantic entropy, removing test-time sampling cost.

title: Kernel Language Entropy: Fine-grained Uncertainty Quantification for LLMs from Semantic Similarities
contribution: Uses von Neumann entropy of semantic kernels over sampled answers, generalising semantic entropy from hard clusters to graded similarity.

title: INSIDE: LLMs' Internal States Retain the Power of Hallucination Detection
contribution: Measures the log-determinant of the covariance of sampled responses' hidden-state embeddings, with test-time clipping of extreme activations.

title: Shifting Attention to Relevance: Towards the Predictive Uncertainty Quantification of Free-Form Large Language Models
contribution: Reweights token- and sentence-level uncertainty by semantic relevance so that uninformative tokens do not dominate predictive entropy (SAR).

title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
contribution: Samples diverse chain-of-thought paths and takes a majority vote; reports that vote agreement correlates with accuracy.

title: LUQ: Long-text Uncertainty Quantification for LLMs
contribution: Scores long-text uncertainty by sentence-level NLI support across sampled responses and picks the least uncertain model in an ensemble.

title: Graph-based Uncertainty Metrics for Long-form Language Model Outputs
contribution: Builds a bipartite graph of sampled responses and extracted claims and uses centrality as claim confidence, then keeps only confident claims when decoding.

title: Semantic Density: Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models through Confidence Measurement in Semantic Space
contribution: Scores each response by a probability-weighted kernel density of reference samples in semantic embedding space.

title: Improving Uncertainty Estimation through Semantically Diverse Language Generation
contribution: Generates semantically diverse alternatives by substituting important tokens (SDLG) and importance-weights them to estimate semantic entropy with fewer samples.

title: LM-Polygraph: Uncertainty Estimation for Language Models
contribution: Open-source framework implementing white- and black-box uncertainty estimators for LLMs, with benchmarks and a chat demo showing confidence.

title: Fact-Checking the Output of Large Language Models via Token-Level Uncertainty Quantification
contribution: Claim-Conditioned Probability keeps only the alternative-token mass that changes a claim's meaning and aggregates it per claim for fact-checking.

title: Benchmarking Uncertainty Quantification Methods for Large Language Models with LM-Polygraph
contribution: Large benchmark of LLM uncertainty methods, including sampling-based ones, across QA, translation and summarization, with confidence normalisation.

title: Uncertainty Estimation in Autoregressive Structured Prediction
contribution: Probabilistic framework for token- and sequence-level uncertainty in autoregressive models via ensembles and Monte Carlo approximation, splitting knowledge and data uncertainty.

title: Selectively Answering Ambiguous Questions
contribution: Shows that repetition and diversity of sampled answers give better calibrated confidence for selective answering of ambiguous questions than likelihood or self-verification.

title: Decomposing Uncertainty for Large Language Models through Input Clarification Ensembling
contribution: Splits LLM uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic parts by ensembling answers over generated clarifications of the input.

title: SAC3: Reliable Hallucination Detection in Black-Box Language Models via Semantic-aware Cross-check Consistency
contribution: Adds semantically equivalent question perturbations and cross-model verification to self-consistency to catch consistent but wrong answers (SAC3).

title: Quantifying Uncertainty in Answers from any Language Model and Enhancing their Trustworthiness
contribution: Combines observed consistency of sampled answers with self-reflection certainty into one confidence score for any black-box LLM (BSDetector).

title: Improving Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models via Semantic Embeddings
contribution: Replaces bidirectional entailment with embedding similarity among sampled answers, plus an amortised single-pass latent-variable variant.

title: CSS: Contrastive Semantic Similarity for Uncertainty Quantification of LLMs
contribution: Uses CLIP text-encoder features to build contrastive similarity between sampled generations for spectral-clustering uncertainty.

title: MARS: Meaning-Aware Response Scoring for Uncertainty Estimation in Generative LLMs
contribution: Replaces length-normalised sequence probability with token weights reflecting contribution to meaning, improving probability- and entropy-based scores (MARS).

title: LLM Uncertainty Quantification through Directional Entailment Graph and Claim Level Response Augmentation
contribution: Builds a directed entailment graph over sampled responses, uses random-walk Laplacian features, and augments responses at claim level.

title: Self-contradictory Hallucinations of Large Language Models: Evaluation, Detection and Mitigation
contribution: Detects contradictions between sentences sampled in the same context by prompting, and iteratively revises text to remove them.

title: LM vs LM: Detecting Factual Errors via Cross Examination
contribution: An examiner LM questions the examinee LM over multiple turns to expose inconsistencies that signal factual errors.

title: Calibrating Long-form Generations from Large Language Models
contribution: Treats correctness and confidence of long-form answers as distributions, proposes matching calibration metrics, and elicits confidence by self-consistency and self-evaluation.

title: Cycles of Thought: Measuring LLM Confidence through Stable Explanations
contribution: Treats sampled explanations as test-time classifiers and forms a posterior answer distribution weighted by explanation entailment.

title: Knowing What LLMs DO NOT Know: A Simple Yet Effective Self-Detection Method
contribution: Rephrases a question several times and uses divergence among the answers to flag questions the model does not know.

title: Enhancing Uncertainty-Based Hallucination Detection with Stronger Focus
contribution: Reference-free hallucination score that focuses on key tokens, propagates unreliable context through attention and corrects token probabilities by entity type.

title: Word-Sequence Entropy: Towards Uncertainty Estimation in Free-Form Medical Question Answering Applications and Beyond
contribution: Calibrates uncertainty at word and sequence level by semantic relevance for free-form medical QA and uses it to pick more reliable responses.

title: The Internal State of an LLM Knows When It's Lying
contribution: Trains a classifier on LLM hidden activations to predict whether a statement the model reads or generates is true (SAPLMA).

title: To Believe or Not to Believe Your LLM
contribution: Derives an information-theoretic epistemic-uncertainty score from iterative prompting with previous answers, separating epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty.

title: Chainpoll: A high efficacy method for LLM hallucination detection
contribution: Repeatedly asks a judge LLM with chain-of-thought whether a completion is hallucinated and averages the votes; releases the RealHall benchmark.

title: Calibrating Large Language Models with Sample Consistency
contribution: Derives confidence from agreement, entropy and first-second distance of sampled answers and studies how prompting, scale and tuning affect calibration.

title: Atomic Calibration of LLMs in Long-Form Generations
contribution: Evaluates calibration at the level of atomic claims in long-form answers and combines generative (sample-consistency) and discriminative confidence.

title: Look Before You Leap: An Exploratory Study of Uncertainty Measurement for Large Language Models
contribution: Empirical study of sampling- and likelihood-based uncertainty measures for LLMs across NLP and code generation tasks.

title: Unsupervised Quality Estimation for Neural Machine Translation
contribution: Unsupervised quality estimation for machine translation from glass-box signals, including Monte Carlo dropout variance and lexical similarity of sampled translations.

title: On Hallucination and Predictive Uncertainty in Conditional Language Generation
contribution: Links hallucination in captioning and data-to-text to token-level epistemic uncertainty and proposes uncertainty-aware beam search.

title: Beyond Semantic Entropy: Boosting LLM Uncertainty Quantification with Pairwise Semantic Similarity
contribution: SNNE uses intra- and inter-cluster pairwise similarity of samples in a nearest-neighbour entropy estimate, generalising semantic entropy.

title: Semantic Energy: Detecting LLM Hallucination Beyond Entropy
contribution: Replaces probabilities in semantic entropy with a Boltzmann energy from logits over semantic clusters, catching cases where all samples agree but are wrong.

title: Just rephrase it! Uncertainty estimation in closed-source language models via multiple rephrased queries
contribution: Queries a closed-source LLM with rule-based rephrasings of the input and uses answer agreement as calibrated confidence, with a theoretical account.

title: SPUQ: Perturbation-Based Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models
contribution: Perturbs inputs and sampling settings, then aggregates similarity of sampled outputs to capture both epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty (SPUQ).

title: Do Language Models Know When They're Hallucinating References?
contribution: Detects hallucinated references by checking consistency of repeated direct and indirect queries, such as author lists, about a generated citation.

title: Semantic Volume: Quantifying and Detecting both External and Internal Uncertainty in LLMs
contribution: Measures dispersion of perturbed queries or sampled responses as the Gram-determinant volume of their embeddings, covering query ambiguity and model uncertainty.

title: Uncertainty in Language Models: Assessment through Rank-Calibration
contribution: Proposes rank-calibration and its error metric to assess LM uncertainty measures without thresholding correctness, with indication diagrams.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for In-Context Learning of Large Language Models
contribution: Decomposes in-context learning uncertainty into demonstration-induced aleatoric and model-configuration epistemic parts using sampled generations.

title: Factual Confidence of LLMs: on Reliability and Robustness of Current Estimators
contribution: Systematic comparison of factual confidence estimators (probes, verbalised, consistency, logits) and of their stability across paraphrases.

title: Assessing Correctness in LLM-Based Code Generation via Uncertainty Estimation
contribution: Adapts entropy and mutual-information uncertainty to code by clustering sampled programs with symbolic execution, and adds an abstention policy.

title: Unsupervised Real-Time Hallucination Detection based on the Internal States of Large Language Models
contribution: Trains a lightweight classifier on internal states from automatically generated data for real-time hallucination detection (MIND) and releases the HELM benchmark.

title: HaloScope: Harnessing Unlabeled LLM Generations for Hallucination Detection
contribution: Estimates truthful versus hallucinated membership of unlabeled generations from a latent subspace, then trains a truthfulness classifier (HaloScope).

title: Hallucination Detection on a Budget: Efficient Bayesian Estimation of Semantic Entropy
contribution: Bayesian estimator of semantic entropy with adaptive per-query sampling that matches hallucination detection with fewer samples.

title: Too Consistent to Detect: A Study of Self-Consistent Errors in LLMs
contribution: Shows that errors repeated across samples persist or grow with scale and evade consistency-based detectors, and proposes a cross-model hidden-state probe.

title: VL-Uncertainty: Detecting Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Model via Uncertainty Estimation
contribution: Detects vision-language model hallucinations from answer entropy across semantically equivalent visual (blur) and textual (rephrase) prompt perturbations.

title: IUQ: Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification for Long-Form Large Language Model Generation
contribution: Samples long-form responses, decomposes them into claims and interrogates the model to combine inter-sample and intra-sample claim consistency (IUQ).

title: SeSE: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models Based on Structural Information Theory
contribution: Builds semantic graphs over samples and uses hierarchical structural entropy of encoding trees for black-box uncertainty in short and long-form generation (SeSE).

title: Using Semantic Distance to Estimate Uncertainty in LLM-Based Code Generation
contribution: Weighs disagreement among sampled programs by how far their fuzzed execution behaviours differ, for code correctness uncertainty.

title: Functional Entropy: Predicting Functional Correctness in LLM-Generated Code with Uncertainty Quantification
contribution: Clusters sampled programs by functional equivalence instead of NLI and computes entropy-style scores to predict code correctness across languages.

title: Simple Yet Effective: An Information-Theoretic Approach to Multi-LLM Uncertainty Quantification
contribution: Selects and aggregates well-calibrated subsets of diverse LLMs using Jensen-Shannon divergence for multi-model uncertainty (MUSE).

title: Complementing Self-Consistency with Cross-Model Disagreement for Uncertainty Quantification
contribution: Adds an epistemic term from inter- versus intra-model semantic similarity to self-consistency, flagging confident errors that single-model sampling misses.

title: Language Model Uncertainty Quantification with Attention Chain
contribution: Backtracks attention to a short chain of answer-relevant tokens and aggregates their probabilities as confidence for reasoning outputs (UQAC).

title: Efficient Hallucination Detection for LLMs Using Uncertainty-Aware Attention Heads
contribution: Detects uncertainty-aware attention heads and recurrently combines their attention drop with token confidence in a single forward pass (RAUQ).

title: Efficient Hallucination Detection: Adaptive Bayesian Estimation of Semantic Entropy with Guided Semantic Exploration
contribution: Hierarchical Bayesian estimation of semantic entropy with guided perturbation-based exploration and variance-based stopping of sampling.

title: Strength in Numbers: Estimating Confidence of Large Language Models by Prompt Agreement
contribution: Estimates confidence from agreement of predictions across multiple human-written and generated prompts for the same multiple-choice question.

title: Bayesian Prompt Ensembles: Model Uncertainty Estimation for Black-Box Large Language Models
contribution: Weights semantically equivalent instruction prompts by approximate variational inference on a small labeled set to form a calibrated ensemble.
